_comment: MEASURED (hull.mjs --write-frame --from hull, 2026-10-04): the VISUAL HULL of the registered turnaround (subjects/shrink_ray/turnaround: side / front / rear / top foregrounds, 0.00158 m voxels refined x4, 1971955 surface / shell points) projected through subjects/shrink_ray/camera.json; its bbox fitted to the concept foreground bbox (s = mean of the x / y px-per-m, centres matched). _frame.note: quadPx = the registered.mjs anchorFace corners (+X flank of the class default body) placed with the fitted s / ox / oy, so registration() recovers them exactly (rms 0); sPxPerM.xOverY != 1 = the concept's aspect differs from the turnaround's (drift); the module's frameScale / frameX / frameY knobs refine the fit
